label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) is FP: user input from cookie flows through URL decoding, then through doSomething() unchanged, becomes fileName, and is passed through ESAPI.encodeForHTML() before being printed to response.getWriter() - encoding mitigates XSS. Alert 2 (java/path-injection) is TP: same user input flow reaches new File(fileName) sink without any validation or sanitization against path traversal patterns (../), allowing attackers to manipulate file system paths via cookie.

evidence.note: Path injection flow: cookie->decode->param->bar->fileName->new File(fileName); no sanitization against path traversal
